user.title: SmartThings Find
user.description: How should Home Assistant sign in to SmartThings Find? With the Samsung Account it renews the session by itself; a cookie has to be replaced whenever Samsung ends the session.

account.title: Samsung Account
account.description:
1. Copy this [Samsung Account sign-in link]({login_url}) (right-click → *Copy link*), but do not open it yet.
2. In a new browser tab on a computer, press **F12**, open the **Network** tab and tick **Preserve log** (Firefox: ⚙ → **Persist Logs**).
3. Paste the link in that tab and sign in, with the second factor if asked. At the end the page seems to do nothing: that is expected.
4. Type `ms-app` in the **Filter** box of the Network tab, right-click the request that appears → **Copy** → **Copy URL**, and paste it below **right away** (the code in it expires in a few minutes).

Home Assistant keeps the resulting authorization and signs in a new SmartThings Find session by itself whenever Samsung ends the current one. Your password never reaches Home Assistant.

data_description.active_interval: Minimum time between automatic location requests to the same device. Requests are only sent on updates, so the real interval is rounded up to the next update.
data_description.max_location_age: After this, the tracker stops reporting the old position (state unknown), so `person` falls back to its other trackers.

Change it per device with its *Automatic location update* switch.

cookie.title: Cookie header
cookie.description:
1. Open a **private browser window** and sign in to [{stf_url}]({stf_url}).
2. Open Developer Tools (F12) → Network and reload the page.
3. Select the `chkLogin.do` request and copy its whole `Cookie` request header.
4. Close the private window **without signing out**, and do not use that session in the browser again: Samsung may end a session that is used in two places.

init.title: SmartThings Find
init.description:
With a Samsung Account sign-in the session renews itself. With a cookie, paste a new Cookie header only to replace the current session.

**Modes** (the default for each device; change it per device with its *Automatic location update* switch)
- Passive: read the last position Samsung has (no extra battery use).
- Active: ask the device for its position automatically, at most once per automatic update interval (fresher, uses the device's battery).
